in_sanskrit.name: Kranthi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breakthrough, Progress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kranthi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kranthi is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kru' meaning to do and 'nt' meaning to break, shatter or burst open. The name Kranthi signifies the act of breaking through obstacles or making progress. It is a powerful name for a girl symbolizing courage, determination and the strength to overcome challenges.
